steps: On a repaired approved build, enable a real screen reader (for example VoiceOver or NVDA) and use the provisioned synthetic persona.
Complete review entry, all bounded edits, evidence open/close, recoverable validation and generic error handling using keyboard only.
Confirm dialog names, field labels, error descriptions, status announcements, focus containment, receipt heading and return navigation; record actual announced text and focus.

items.topic: Physical mobile keyboard and native date picker
steps: Use actual mobile hardware at the required narrow widths with the approved local/test environment.
Open review, focus date and other fields to display the real software keyboard; set, clear and edit the date through the native picker.
Scroll while the keyboard is visible; verify warnings and primary/cancel/close controls stay reachable without overlap and that date/route state survives navigation.

items.topic: Reduced motion and exact zoom matrix
steps: On the repaired approved build, set a real reduced-motion preference and confirm the browser reports it; inspect review/evidence/receipt opening and closing.
Set the required 1280×800 base viewport and actual 200% browser zoom, then inspect review, localized errors and receipt in both locales.
Record actual native zoom, viewport/DPR, overflow, focused controls and screenshots; restore the prior preference/zoom after testing.
